design.gate: >=46 cell lines x >=10 features AND ablation >= +0.005 R2

access_probes_2026_10_21.DepMap: HTTP 200, Cloudflare Turnstile challenge; body is HTML, not CSV
access_probes_2026_10_21.GEO GSE36133 (CCLE): reachable, RAW.tar only (per-sample CEL files, needs RMA)

unmatchable_lines.HELA: HeLa is excluded from CCLE (contamination history)
unmatchable_lines.HEK293: HEK293 is not a cancer line and is not in the CCLE panel
unmatchable_lines.A2780: A2780 is not in the CCLE panel
unmatchable_lines.A2780CISR: resistant sub-line; no DepMap counterpart exists
unmatchable_lines.A549CISR: resistant sub-line; no DepMap counterpart exists
unmatchable_lines.MCF7CISR: resistant sub-line; no DepMap counterpart exists
unmatchable_lines.HCT116CISR: resistant sub-line; no DepMap counterpart exists

identity_mismatch.note: These lines cannot be matched to CCLE/DepMap regardless of download access: HeLa is excluded from CCLE, HEK293 is not a cancer line, A2780 is outside the CCLE panel, and the CISR lines are resistant derivatives with no DepMap counterpart.

verdict_reason: Two independent failures. Access: every programmatic route is blocked (Cloudflare, 410, timeout, or CEL-only). Identity: the lines that dominate MSRS include five that have no CCLE/DepMap counterpart by construction, so even a successful download would not reach the 46-line gate. The second failure is a property of the corpus and will not improve with retries, so B2 closes.
what_would_unblock: A cell-line panel that includes resistant derivatives and non-CCLE lines, or an MSRS-specific annotation effort. Neither is a download.
